source_caption:
🎥🎬: Fightland (2026)

In a city where underground fights are fueled by power, money, and reputation, every contender is fighting for more than just a win. As tensions rise between competing factions, the people at the center of the action must balance loyalty, ambition, and survival.

The series explores how personal relationships become entangled with the brutal world of illegal combat, where every choice has lasting consequences. With danger around every corner, trust is fragile and no one escapes the pressure unchanged.

Driven by gripping drama and intense confrontations, Fightland delivers a story about resilience, sacrifice, and the pursuit of respect in a world that never stops testing its fighters.

#Fightland #STARZ #CrimeDrama #ActionSeries #UndergroundFighting

source_details.title: Fightland
source_details.synopsis: Fightland is a boxing crime drama television series created by Daniel Fajemisin-Duncan, Marlon Smith, Damione Macedon and Raphael Jackson Jr.. It premiered on July 31, 2026, on Starz in the United States and August 27, 2026, on Sky Atlantic in the United Kingdom.
